department: William H. Miller III Department of Physics & Astronomy

deadline.value: December 15 preceding September entry; year inferred. Vivien Thomas Scholars Initiative applicants must submit by Dec 1.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for students wishing to matriculate in September is the preceding December 15.

gre_subject.quote: Note: submission of General GRE and Physics GRE scores is optional.

funding.value: All graduate students are appointed as TAs or RAs, which provide tuition, stipend and benefits
funding.quote: As part of the program of study, all graduate students are appointed as teaching or research assistants, positions which provide tuition, living stipend, and benefits (health coverage, etc).

entry_route.value: Final-year bachelor's students can apply and must show a completed degree before starting; PhD only, no separate master's (MA awarded en route)
entry_route.quote: In the case of students in the final year of their bachelors program, the official transcript must show completion of all coursework required for the degree. | There is no separate Masters Degree program and no provision for part-time students.

gre_general.quote: Note: submission of General GRE and Physics GRE scores is optional.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 is the preferred minimum (worded as a preference, not a hard cutoff); IELTS also accepted
toefl_min.quote: Johns Hopkins prefers a minimum score of 600 (paper-based) or 250 (computer-based) or 100 (Internet-based) on the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL).

notes: JHU graduate admissions and Krieger school sites blocked automated fetches (403). Admitted PhD students can apply for a $1,500 need-based relocation grant.
